web/row-avatar: The avatar cell inside ResourceView rows.
web/sheet-grid: No story or demo page yet: add a story under apps/sample/stories/.

web/starters: Data, not components: the seven starter app themes (STARTER_THEMES, getStarterTheme, withPairedBrand in packages/ui/src/themes).
web/tanstack-router: The TanStack Router adapter; this app runs React Router.
web/toolbar: No story or demo page yet: add a story under apps/sample/stories/.
web/undo-toast: The undo toast after a delete in the list screens.
web/use-announcer: A screen-reader announcer hook: no visible UI.
web/use-followed-state: An internal hook of EventCalendar and ResourceCalendar, not exported.
web/use-resource-table: ResourcePage's logic without its markup; /items-custom shows the composed version.
web/values: Filter-value helpers for a calendar's window: no UI of their own.
web/view-form: A hook, not a component: ResourceView and ResourceForm build their forms with it, shown wherever the sample app opens a view's form.
web/view-list: Hooks the list and the calendar share (filters, select, enabled, live, the peek's fields): shown by every ResourceView page and the EventCalendar stories.
web/view-settings: The view settings menu inside the list screens.
web/visually-hidden: No story or demo page yet: add a story under apps/sample/stories/.
